title: Fourier Weight in Terms of the Set Mass
statement: For each natural number $q$, let $A_q$ be the upper-tail indicator on the selected Boolean cube used to define the optimality function, and write $\delta_q=2\mathbb{E}A_q$. Form $F_q$ on the cube with one additional coordinate by setting it equal to $1$ when the remaining coordinates lie in the set and equal to the first coordinate otherwise. Then $W_1(F_q)=1-\delta_q+\delta_q^2/4+W_1(A_q)$.
caveat: The selected dimension and upper-tail set are defined through an existence-based construction in the supplied context.
